leadText:
This is the ninth chapter of the Pokémon Mezastar: Aim to Be a Tag Master! manga. It was first published in the August 2022 issue of CoroCoro Ichiban!, released on June 21, 2022. It is 18 pages long.

It was made available on Weekly CoroCoro Comics on November 27, 2023.
